findings.reason: the maps are the plan's own reuse evidence and their staleness is the one way they can still cause a duplicate; re-pointing each verdict at the current head, or stamping the map with the revision a node should re-read, is a one-line change that removes the risk.
findings.text: three of the four reuse-map artifacts are keyed to base revisions older than the current plan (`593f237`, `5384182`, `4e48e772e55a`, all ancestors of the plan's own `plan-commits`), so their `absent`/`partial` verdicts describe a tree the plan has since changed; a worker dispatched today on §13 rows 1/6 or §17 row 3 from those maps would rebuild already-landed machinery (`--wave` default join; `_token_between` at `recovery.py`).

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the design hides substantial behaviour behind existing deep owners rather than spreading shallow wrappers: liveness derivation stays in `runs.py` (`project_watch_visibility` / `producer_live`), classification in `recovery.py` (`classify_pointer`), row rendering in `ticker.py`, the promoted record in `promotion.py`, spend folding in `metering.py`, the manifest reader in `reports.py`, lane probes in `flight.py`. Every measure names the owner it extends.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — no proposed mechanism re-implements an owner: §3 routes `crew gc` through the existing `resolve_dispatch_authority`/`resolve_dispatch_ledger_root` (`routing.py:774,838`) instead of `cli._repo_root`; §13 row 10 cites `metering.is_durable` (`metering.py:233`) as one implementation with two callers; §19 M2 reuses `metering.accumulate_run_spend` (`metering.py:601`) on the promotion ordering rather than re-deriving spend in the watch loop, as the reuse map instructs.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan cites four reuse-map artifacts (`display-reuse-map.md`; `display-truth-reuse-wave-soft-limit.md`; `display-truth-reuse-promotion-row.md`; `display-truth-reuse-refusal-classifier.md`) that map each measure row across §2–§5, §13, §15–§20 to an existing surface at a named revision with `fits`/`needs-extension`/`does-not-fit` verdicts and `file:symbol` citations, and the plan records the currency correction its own search produced (§5 `nothing maps a spec level to a backend` is retracted against `by_spec_level.<level>.backend`, present at `_flight_schema.py:273` and `routing.py:90`).
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the three places the plan adds a surface each justify why the owner cannot carry it: §17's worker message has no existing channel (`grep -rn "def send\|message_worker" reckon/crew/` returns none, and a mid-turn worker is unreachable by `crew resume`), §18 M3's queue probe was superseded rather than added (`flight._probe_serving` / `probe_availability` at `flight.py:1446,1518` read the endpoints document), and §13's wave id reuses the ledger field rather than a second index.
